```{r}
library(sf)
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(terra)
library(exactextractr)
# library(jsonlite)
# library(stringr)   
library(ggplot2)
library(munsell)
library(mapview)
```

```{r}    
source(here::here("inc/landcover-functions.R"))
```

```{r}
#| label: load data
here::i_am("indicator/download.qmd")
slc_aoo <- st_read(
    here::here("gisdata/TEC/Swamps-Fleurieu-IM_AOO.gpkg")) |> 
    st_transform(st_crs(r0)) |>
    slice(1)
slc_imap <- st_read(
    here::here("gisdata/TEC/Swamps-Fleurieu-IM.gpkg")) |> 
    st_transform(st_crs(r0)) |>
    st_crop(slc_aoo)
```

Here we focus on this region of the Fleurieu Peninsula:
```{r}
#| label: map of the cell
mapview(slc_aoo) + mapview(slc_imap)
```

First, we read the information of the landcover raster and confirm that the spatial extent matches the location of the grid cell:
```{r}
#| label: confirm location matches
r0 <- rast(here::here("gisdata/landcover/lc-cell-0.tif"))
names(r0) <- 1988:2024
plot(r0,1)
plot(st_geometry(slc_aoo),add=TRUE,col=NA, border="red", lwd=2)
plot(st_geometry(slc_imap),add=TRUE,border="red", lwd=4)
```

Now we can extract the land cover information for the whole gridcell and indicative map polygons within this area:

```{r}
#| label: extract land cover data
qry_aoo <- exact_extract(r0, slc_aoo)
qry_imap <- exact_extract(r0, slc_imap)
```

We use our custom function `code2lc` to convert the land cover codes into the corresponding classes, vegetation types and cover levels, and then we can summarise the results by year and class or vegetation type:

```{r}
res <- code2lc(qry_aoo, as.character(1988:2024))
res |> group_by(class,year) |> summarise(total=sum(count)) |>
ggplot( aes(x=year, y=total, fill=class)) + 
    geom_area()
```

```{r}
res |> group_by(vegetation,year) |> summarise(total=sum(count)) |>
ggplot( aes(x=year, y=total, fill=vegetation)) + 
    geom_area()
```

```{r}
res <- code2lc(qry_imap, as.character(1988:2024))
res |> group_by(class,year) |> summarise(total=sum(count)) |>
ggplot( aes(x=year, y=total, fill=class)) + 
    geom_area()

res |> group_by(vegetation,class,year) |> summarise(total=sum(count)) |>
ggplot( aes(x=year, y=total, alpha=class,fill=vegetation)) + 
    geom_area()

res |> group_by(vegetation,cover,year) |> summarise(total=sum(count)) |>
ggplot( aes(x=year, y=total, fill=vegetation + cover)) + 
    geom_area()
```


```{r}
clrs <- c(
    mnsl(sapply(0:3, lighter, col = "5R 4/8")),
    mnsl(sapply(0:3, darker, col = "5BG 7/4"))
    )

grouped_res <- res |> 
    mutate(
        vegetation = factor(vegetation, levels=c("Herbaceous","Woody","none")),
        cover = factor(cover, levels=c("Sparse (4 to 15 %)","Open (15 to 40 %)","Open (40 to 65 %)","Closed (> 65 %)","none")),
        vegcover=interaction(vegetation,cover, drop=TRUE,lex.order = TRUE)) |> 
        filter(class %in% c("Natural Terrestrial Vegetated", "Cultivated Terrestrial Vegetated")) |>
        group_by(class,patch,vegcover,year) |> 
        summarise(total=sum(count), .groups="drop")

ggplot(grouped_res, aes(x=year, y=total, fill=vegcover)) + 
    geom_area() + scale_fill_manual(values=clrs) +
    facet_grid(patch ~ class) +
    theme_linedraw() +
    theme(legend.position = "right")
```
